definitions.explanation: The state of living without family members or roommates; single-person household.

examples.japanese: {大学生|だいがくせい}になって{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started living alone when I became a university student.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしは{寂|さび}しいこともある。
examples.english: Living alone can sometimes be lonely.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし{用|よう}のアパートを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for an apartment for living alone.

notes:
COMPOUND: {一人|ひとり} (one person, alone) + {暮|く}らし (living, life)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしをする (to live alone)
- {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}める (to start living alone)
- {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし{向|む}け (for single-person households)
- {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし{用|よう} (for living alone)

In Japan, many young people start {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし when they enter university or start working, especially if they move to a different city.

RELATED:
- {暮|く}らし (living, livelihood)
- {独身|どくしん} (single, unmarried)
